sys_script_client.description: Client-side validation for the Training Date field. It triggers an asynchronous GlideAjax call to the TrainingCheckUtils script include whenever the training date or course is changed. If a conflict is detected (i.e., the course is already scheduled for that date), it clears the field, displays an error message, and alerts the user to prevent duplicate bookings.
sys_script_client.name: Check Duplicate Schedule on Change
